description: A salary calculator that goes hourly to annual and back — the same pay written every way, before tax. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

amount.description: The gross pay figure you already know, in any currency; no tax or deductions are applied. It is converted to all five periods using the working pattern below.

daysPerWeek.description: Days worked in a normal week, used for the daily figure. Defaults to 5.

hoursPerWeek.description: Hours worked in a normal week, used to turn an hourly rate into a weekly one and back. Defaults to 37.5; 40 is usual in the US.

period.description: Which period amount covers. A month is always a twelfth of a year, never 4.33 weeks.

weeksPerYear.description: Weeks paid in a year, used to turn a weekly figure into an annual one and back. Defaults to 52; use 52.18 to count the odd days.

name: salary_calculator
title: Salary Calculator
